posts.title: Now at ECW: Lost Civil War Films of the Silent Era
posts.description: In my latest for Emerging Civil War, I explore lost Civil War films of the Silent Era. 1911–1915 marked the Civil War’s semicentennial and coincided with the film industry’s explosive growth. For the first time, Civil War veterans, their children, and their grandchildren could watch battles from distant memory come to life before their eyes. […]
